summary_ja: 銀行法施行令等の一部を改正する政令の施行日（平成26年12月1日）から適用する。
summary_en: Provides that the amendment applies from December 1, 2014, the date the Cabinet Order Partially Amending the Order for Enforcement of the Banking Act, etc. came into force.
paragraphs: Applies from the date of enforcement of the Cabinet Order Partially Amending the Order for Enforcement of the Banking Act, etc. (December 1, 2014).

sections_en.s09: Amending Provision (FSA Public Notice No. 52 of October 22, 2014) (excerpt)
